propositions: Consolidate all structured-mode consumers onto a single one-operation Pydantic path through the PydanticAIRunner facade, removing bespoke retry loops and scheduler delegation.
Output repair is implemented as in-Agent bounded retry (retries={"output":N}) seeded by output_retry_allowance, not a Python-level attempt loop reconstructing fresh Agents.
Retain structured_retry_limit as the output-retry-allowance cap; structured_retry_limit=0 yields zero output-repair retries (single-shot fail-safe) for batch-abstain contracts.
Request budget construction combines request-limit and allowance addend into a single UsageLimits object, ensuring the output-retry counter cannot exhaust before the request budget trips.
Well-formed first response uses exactly one outer agent.run_sync call; only bug-895c native-to-prompted downgrade legitimately yields two; no bespoke fresh-Agent loop produces a third.

All in-tree structured consumers (plan_review, code_review, overlap/judge, enrich, evals, workflow, scripts) verified by mode-resolving AST census to route through the single get_runner facade; no bypass paths remain.
